relationships.subject: galcanezumab
relationships.object: episodic cluster headache total pain burden
relationships.evidence_quote: Galcanezumab significantly reduced mean weekly total pain burden compared with placebo in patients with episodic cluster headache.

key_findings: Galcanezumab 300 mg reduced weekly total pain burden vs placebo in episodic cluster headache (LS mean difference -11.18 severity-weighted hours, p=0.035)
Composite total pain burden showed construct validity against PGI-I ratings
